pages.title: Ordered Collections
pages.content: A list stores multiple items in a single variable. Lists are ordered, changeable, and allow duplicates. Create a list with square brackets `[]` and separate items with commas.

pages.title: Working with Lists
pages.content: Lists are one of the most used data types:
pages.code:
fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]

print(fruits[0])     # apple (first item)
print(fruits[-1])    # cherry (last item)
print(len(fruits))   # 3

# Change an item
fruits[1] = "mango"
print(fruits)  # ['apple', 'mango', 'cherry']

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: What index does the first item of a list have?
pages.explanation: Python lists are zero-indexed, so the first item is at index 0.
